title: Function Vector to Mirror code distillation
hypothesis: A fixed-rank shared decoder and product-quantized Mirror codes compress task function-vector interventions below explicit vector bytes while preserving heldout task quality.
physical_object: one frozen GPT-2 with shared residual intervention decoder at block 6
mirror_coordinate: per-task code m decoded through a paid shared basis/codebook
controls: generic PCA shared basis + FP16 coefficients

development.allowed: fit PCA/codebook only on development task vectors; select K=8 product codebook, block=6 fixed; no fresh-driven changes

success_gate: Direct ICL above chance in each fresh world; Mirror target NLL <=1.05 x explicit-FV NLL; Mirror payload <=0.80 x explicit-FV bytes; report generic PCA at matched rank/bytes.
failure_gate: Direct ICL is valid but Mirror misses quality or byte gate, or simple generic PCA matches/beats Mirror at equal bytes.
not_established_gate: Direct ICL and explicit-FV execution are both at/below chance; vector compression is then representation-only and cannot support useful-function claims.
boundaries: Synthetic GPT-2 tasks only; no natural language or causal-head claim.
A vector compression ratio is not useful-function multiplicity.
Function-space target metrics are required in addition to vector error.
